text: Lianan Sidhe is the name for a fairy lover in Irish lore, also written Liannan-Shee. The term points to a fairy mistress or a fairy bride who pairs with a human. This page is a short marker that leads to the fuller entry for Fairy Lover. The record keeps the name as a cross-reference to that topic.
